name: Kiryuu Hayato
source:
He is the son of the heir to a wealthy local family. He grew up without any problems, but he became tired of his relationship with his father and entered a boarding school.

He never returned home, even on vacations, but after his father's death, he returns to his mansion for the first time in several years.

Shaken by various temptations, he is tossed about by the waves of fate.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=561925&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
